origin: Custom API demonstration, not an official problem or judge sample

domain.coordinate: Successfully parsed finite long double values

output: 1-based input IDs, origin first, counterclockwise [0,2pi), same-ray increasing radius, numerically identical represented points by original ID
arithmetic: Exact ordering of represented binary coordinates. Decimal input rounds first. Signed zero is equivalent. Not arbitrary precision, exact source decimals, general translated orientation, or all RealPlane predicates.
invalid: Formatted extraction failure, out-of-range n, or nonfinite coordinate exits 1. No extra whole-token lexical or EOF validation. A valid numeric prefix or extra trailing input may be accepted outside the valid input protocol. No promise to accept every decimal spelling of a subnormal.
